As for us, with us the word should be explained a hundred times before we know that all this knowledge can be extracted from it. That understanding the Sahaabah had, and now we do not have that understanding. As long as we remain within that understanding, we follow the Sahaabah. When we deviate from the understanding, we no longer follow the Sahaabah and the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam. Is the Qur'aan more or the Sunnah? The Sunnah is much more. And the explanation of the Sahaabah is much more than the Sunnah. With every generation you need more explanation, and that is also what the scholars did: they brought the understanding of the Sahaabah closer so that we can understand it.
Next time [I say] to the sister: it is better that you gather knowledge before you say something.
Question 6
A follow-up question to the fifth
The sister had indicated that [the matter] was clear to them at that time and is not clear to us, and then came with the remark: so you are suggesting that the Qur'aan and the Sunnah are not clear.
The Qur'aan and the Sunnah we cannot understand without the understanding of the Sahaabah. That Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa also said in the Qur'aan: «ومن يُشاقِقِ الرسولَ من بعدِ ما تَبَيَّنَ له الهُدى ويَتَّبِع غيرَ سبيلِ المؤمنين» (the believers here are the Sahaabah) «نُوَلِّه ما تَوَلَّى». Interpretation of the meaning: «And whoever opposes the Messenger after the guidance has become clear to him and follows other than the way of the believers, We shall turn him to what he has turned to.» That is to say: We shall let him go astray and on the Day of Resurrection We shall cast him into the Fire.
When we say «we do not need the Sahaabah, we can understand [the texts] just like this», then that means that we do not follow the Sunnah. Allaah has made clear to us that we cannot understand the Qur'aan and the Sunnah without the explanation of the Sahaabah.
The Qur'aan and the Sunnah are our principal sources, and the explanation of the Sahaabah is their understanding.
That is also what distinguishes us from the rest of the groups. Ahl as-Sunnah follow the Sahaabah, and when we do not follow the Sahaabah, we cannot follow the Sunnah.
The writing down of knowledge is a general act, not an 3ibaadah.
As regards the striking of women the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam uttered several ahaadieth.
Iyaas narrated that the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam said: «لا تَضرِبوا إماءَ الله» — «Do not strike the female servants of Allaah» (the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam forbade it for a time). Then 3umar came and said: «O Messenger of Allaah, the women have become unruly [they have become rebellious and bold].» Whereupon the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam afterwards permitted the striking of the women. Then many women came to the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam complaining to him, whereupon the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam said: «لقد أطافَ ببيتِ محمَّدٍ نساءٌ كثيراتٌ يَشكون». — «Many women have gathered around the house of Muhammad complaining.» And in another narration he says: «of striking». Then he said sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam: «ليس أولئك بخيارِكم». — «Those are not the best of you.» That is to say that those who strike them are not the best of you. This hadieth was declared good (hasan) by imaam al-Albaanie and narrated by imaam [Aboe] Daawoed.
So you see that the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam for a time forbade the striking of women, because it occurred rather frequently, and that it was then permitted when the women became rebellious, and that the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam afterwards disliked the matter but did not forbid it, and said: «Those who strike their women are not the best of you».
And another hadieth, narrated by imaam al-Bukhaarie and imaam Muslim from 3abdullaah ibn Zam3ah, who narrated that he heard the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam say: «لا يَجلِدُ أحدُكم امرأتَه جَلدَ العبدِ ثمَّ يُجامِعُها في آخرِ يومه». Meaning: «Let none of you flog his wife the way a slave is flogged and then be intimate with her at the end of his day.» The Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam uttered this statement out of dislike for this deed. He says: how can one of you strike his wife and then be intimate with her at the end of the day — that [does not] go together. By this he makes clear that the man should not strike his wife. That does not yet mean that it is forbidden. It is forbidden to strike her when she has already ceased the disobedience.
The special rule here in the Netherlands is that it is not correct that the woman be struck.
Until now we have dealt with the treatment or the stages for the man in which he rectifies and improves his wife with more than merely the admonition.
How is it with the woman who fears that her husband is naashiz or turns away from her?
Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa has in this too given guidelines to the woman by which she can act. When the woman fears that her husband will become naashiz or turn away from her (that is, leave her for a long period), or when he wants to give her the talaaq while she still wants to remain with him, or leaves her so that he neither lives with her nor gives her the talaaq — in all these situations the woman has the possibility to first give up some of the rights that she has, that is, to relinquish them, in order to preserve her husband. Because preserving her husband and her remaining married is a better situation than that she gets the talaaq and becomes single and has no husband at all.
So either she preserves the husband but reduces her rights, for example that she gives up part of her maintenance. That is to say that she has patience with the little, the least, or — for example — with less intercourse; or, when he is married to another woman, that she relinquishes her night, one time or for a long period, because the fact that he remains her husband and that she is cared for and protected — then she has in any case a great form of care, and also the fact that [she] has a man above her — is better than that she remains without a man, gets the talaaq and afterwards obtains no right at all.
That is a possibility for choice.
This possibility Sawdah bint Zam3ah chose. She was one of the wives of the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam. 3aa-ishah radiyallaahu 3anhaa (may Allaah be pleased with her) narrates in a hadieth narrated by imaam Aboe Daawoed; she said to 3urwah: «O son of my sister (that is, the son of my sister; 3urwah was married to the sister of 3aa-ishah), the Messenger of Allaah sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam did not give one of us preference over the other in the division of his staying with us, and hardly a day passed without his going around to all of us and drawing near to each woman without touching, until he reached the one whose day it was, and then he would spend the night with her. And Sawdah bint Zam3ah said, when she had grown old and feared that the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam would part from her: O Messenger of Allaah, my day is for 3aa-ishah, whereupon he sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam accepted that from her.» Sawdah said: «Then Allaah revealed concerning me and concerning whoever was like me», after which she recited the verse that we just mentioned: «وإنِ امرأةٌ خافَتْ من بَعلِها نُشوزًا...». Interpretation of the meaning: «And if a woman fears from her husband disobedience...» That means, then, that Sawdah feared that the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam no longer wanted to be with her, and that she therefore gave her night to 3aa-ishah, because she knew that the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam loved 3aa-ishah more. She relinquished something of her right in order to remain under the authority of her husband.
Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa says here: «فلا جُناحَ عليهما أن يُصلِحا بينهما صُلحًا، والصُّلحُ خير». Interpretation of the meaning: «Then there is no sin upon them both if they bring about a reconciliation between them, and reconciliation is better.» However, [there are] now sisters who contradict the words of Allaah; they say: how can reconciliation be better? Why should I remain with my husband, I can take care of myself, I get my own house from the state, I can go and come where I want. I do not need that man, I do not want intercourse at all. That a woman said literally. That is an arrogant woman who was punished with her statement, whereby she took off her hidjaab, left off her khimaar (head-veil), works among the men, and does not live by the pleasure of Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa.
When Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa says «and reconciliation is better», then it is so. That you reduce your rights is better than that you remain without a husband. The man is not merely something for sex; the man is protection, tranquillity and embrace. That is what the marriage revolves around: the tranquillity, the good and the stability. That you will no longer have when you have no husband.
So this, then, is how the woman should deal with her affair.
When the disputes grow large, then a step other than merely the treatment within the house should be taken. That step is that a reconciling factor from outside is considered.
And that too is what Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa says in Soerat An-Nisaa-e: 35: «وإن خِفتُم شِقاقَ بينهما فابعَثوا حَكَمًا من أهلِه وحَكَمًا من أهلِها، إن يُريدا إصلاحًا يُوَفِّقِ اللهُ بينهما، إنَّ اللهَ كان عليمًا خبيرًا». Interpretation of the meaning: «And if you fear a breach between them both, then send an arbiter (hakam) from his family and an arbiter from her family; if they both wish reconciliation, then Allaah will bring about agreement between them both. Verily, Allaah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.» (Soerat An-Nisaa-e, verse 35).
This verse is a foundation in reconciliation. The first part of the foundation, then: if all the matters that we just mentioned do not help, then there is [one] matter: when a gap, a breach (shiqaaq) is feared, then someone from his side and someone from her side should be sent. Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa called them both «hakam», and the hakam is someone who judges, a wise person, and whoever is wise should also be someone who has knowledge.
When from his side there is a wise person who has more knowledge, and from her side likewise the same, and they come together to decide in the matter, then it is important that the two persons do not take sides but choose the truth, choose the good, and choose the reconciliation between them both. Therefore Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa commanded that there be [people] from his side and from her side. To maintain and safeguard the objectivity.
Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa has established a cosmic law (sunnah kawniyyah). That is the second part of the foundation. He says: «إن يُريدا إصلاحًا يُوَفِّقِ اللهُ بينهما». Interpretation of the meaning: «If they both wish reconciliation, then Allaah will bring about agreement between them both.» This is an extremely important matter. It means, then, that if one of the two does not want (in his heart) the reconciliation, then the reconciliation also does not happen. This is therefore a call to them both to want the reconciliation. Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa calls the reconciliation here «islaah (setting right)». And «islaah» is a comprehensive concept for several meanings:
When the other has violated the right, that the other returns his right or apologizes.
The setting right with the other.
The reconciliation with the other.
The setting right with yourself, the setting right with the other, and the reconciliation with the other.
The setting right with yourself means that you first rectify yourself. And the setting right with the other is that you rectify your affair whereby you return his right, and the third is that you also reconcile with him, that is to say that you set right with the other and no longer look back and do not look behind, but look ahead, to the solution and the improvement.
That is what Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa has made a condition at which the reconciliation between them both happens. Therefore Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa says: «Verily, Allaah is All-Knowing». Of what you both want, and He knows what will happen. This is a call from Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa that they both also be truthful with Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa and with themselves. That is to say that they both be truthful with Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa and with themselves, and that whoever wants the good also need not worry, because Allaah knows what the other wants. When Allaah knows that the other wants the setting right, the rectification and the reconciliation, then Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa will also bring about the reconciliation between them both. This is a promise from Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa. Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa places here a condition and a promise. The condition is that they both want the setting right in the best manner, and the promise is that He reconciles between them both. One should not worry about the reconciliation but about his sincerity, his setting right, and his reconciliation with the other; then Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa rectifies [the matter] between them both.
If we know these matters and know these definitions, then we also know how we as man and woman can draw near to one another and improve with one another. The improvement is only in the hand of Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa, therefore it is important that there be sincerity (ikhlaas) in this too.
Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa also makes clear that in such situations one must beware of the whisperings (wasaawis) of the shaytaan. What are the whisperings of the shaytaan?
Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa makes clear which doors of the shaytaan can be opened at that moment, in Soerat An-Nisaa-e: 128. Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa says therein: «وأُحضِرَتِ الأنفُسُ الشُّحَّ». Interpretation of the meaning: «And the souls have been made prone to niggardliness (shuhh).» That is to say that the niggardliness will be awakened in the souls at that moment. The shuhh means here that you stand up for yourself. It does not concern you what the other wants, it does not concern you where the other goes, but you want to oppose the other. Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa makes clear here that one must beware of this. Parties will arise. This one stands up for himself and the other also stands up for himself.
How can one guard against that? Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa says after it: «وإن تُحسِنوا وتَتَّقوا فإنَّ اللهَ كان بما تَعمَلونَ خبيرًا». Interpretation of the meaning: «And if you do good and have taqwaa (God-consciousness), then Allaah is All-Aware of what you do.» That means, then, that at such a moment you should rather do the opposite of what your soul wants to drive you to. Your soul drives you to niggardliness. You should perform ihsaan (doing good). The ihsaan is the doing of good [the performing of the good], that is to say that you rather perform the good for the other and for the sake of Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa. If you have taqwaa in your ihsaan in the good that you perform for the other, then that will remove the shuhh and improve the reconciliation.
The ihsaan is that you rather show at that moment the best of what you have. Do you want that? You obtain it. Rather, before you come to such a conversation, you come with a gift: with a bouquet of flowers, you come with goodness, you begin your words with praise instead of beginning by blaming the other. You begin with sincere praise, not to show the reconciler (al-muslih) how good you are and what a righteous person you are. You should also know that you are dealing with Allaah.
At that moment you should perform the good for the sake of Allaah, that is to say that you have sincerity for the sake of Allaah, that is to say that you seek the reward and do not intend your own nobility [to show]: «look, I am noble, I show that I do good». That is not sincerity but rather contrary to sincerity, because it is arrogance. Then Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa will not facilitate the matter at that moment either. The shaytaan will enter and only make [the matter] more difficult. [What is required] is that you perform the matter only to obtain the reward of Allaah and to belittle the shaytaan. Instead of wanting to humiliate the wife, you go and humiliate the shaytaan.
Then you are at that moment occupied with the good as well.
From 17 March 2019 — in shaa-a Allaah (if Allaah wills)
In the week of 24 March we shall speak about the steps towards the talaaq.
We move on to another topic: the steps towards the improvement, and if the improvement is not possible, then towards the talaaq. We shall also speak about the types of talaaq, the types of faskh (annulment of the marriage), and what the rights and duties are.
So that we then begin a new, third stage, namely the upbringing of the children.
Next week (31 March) — in shaa-a Allaah
We shall speak about the manner in which reconciliation should take place and the manner in which the reconcilers should be. We shall also speak about how the man should behave at that moment and how the woman should behave at that moment, and how [it] is at that moment as regards the children.
Homework
Organizing your notes and studying them for at least two hours.
Saliemah, Nawaal and Ming continue [preparing] the calendar.
Practising the material that we have dealt with. Each does that as he has understood it.
The fifty-first lesson — Sunday 31 March 2019
Homework
Organizing your notes and studying them for at least two hours.
Saliemah, Nawaal and Ming continue [preparing] the calendar.
Practising the material that we have dealt with. Each does that as he has understood it.
Discussion of the homework (31 March 2019)
Discussion of student 1
The sister had focused on strengthening her iemaan (faith). She did that by fasting on Monday voluntarily. And she occupied herself with the Islamic calendar, the acts of worship in each month. [The matter] did not entirely succeed.
The teacher: because time was insufficient for you?
The sister: the communication did not go entirely well.
The teacher: shall we then postpone it to next week, in shaa-a Allaah?
The sister: in shaa-a Allaah. We had made a division of tasks and another sister was going to make a nice document of it, but the sister forgot to send it to the other sister.
The sister noticed that [there are] many innovations (bida3) occurring. There was [a] matter about which the sister had a question (the sacred months — al-ashhur al-hurum): are there also certain things connected with them, or [are there] certain forbidden things such as war?
The teacher: as regards the rights of the sacred months, Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa has mentioned these months in the Qur'aan. He says: «إنَّ عِدَّةَ الشُّهورِ عند الله اثنا عشرَ شهرًا في كتابِ الله يومَ خَلَقَ السمواتِ والأرض، منها أربعةٌ حُرُم» (التوبة: ٣٦). Interpretation of the meaning: «Verily, the number of months with Allaah is twelve months, in the Book of Allaah on the day He created the heavens and the earth; of them are four sacred.» (Soerat At-Tawbah, verse 36).
The four months are: Dhoe l-Hidjjah (the twelfth month), Dhoe l-Qa3dah (the eleventh month), al-Muharram (the first month) and Radjab (we are now in 31 March 2019, the seventh month).
Radjab too is one of the sacred months. What takes place in these months? These Allaah has made special, and many scholars say that in the sacred months the deeds are multiplied [their reward is multiplied]. And they used as proof that Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa also made al-Masdjid al-Haraam (the Sacred Mosque), in which one prayer [is counted as] more than a hundred thousand prayers relative to the prayer in other mosques, [special]. And likewise the sacred precinct of Medina, in which is the mosque of the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam, where the reward is multiplied.
Everything that Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa has made special, such as the position of the wives of the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam, in it He has established two matters, namely that these places, times or persons have a far greater right, but that, if [that] concerns persons, they also have far more duties. Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa says (Soerat al-Ahzaab): «مَن يَأتِ منكنَّ بفاحشةٍ مُبَيِّنةٍ يُضاعَف لها العذابُ ضِعفَين، وكان ذلك على الله يسيرًا». Interpretation of the meaning: «Whoever of you commits a clear indecency, for her the punishment will be doubled twofold, and that is easy for Allaah.» And their reward is multiplied as well. And so some of the Taabi3oen also said that in those times the deeds are multiplied, but in those times the sins are also multiplied [in the punishment], so it is more severe to commit a sin in these months than in other months.
Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa forbade fighting in these months, because these months are months that are not permitted [for fighting]. And that was already so before the legislations of the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam descended, and Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa preserved it. That means that it is not permissible for the Muslims to be the ones who begin entering into a fight. But when they are fought, it is permissible for them to defend themselves, and when they (the disbelievers) have begun in the sacred month, it is also permissible for them to begin.
Question 2
The acts of worship in the month of the sacred months: when you direct your intention towards one of the months, that is, «I will increase my acts of worship», is that permissible, or do you fall into a bid3ah?
From the Prophet sallallaahu 3alayhi wa sallam no specific acts of worship for the sacred months have been narrated, so when you go and specify them with an act of worship it is a bid3ah; but if you do not specify them but merely perform acts of worship because it is the sacred months, then that is permissible.
Al-Basrie (of the Taabi3oen) used to fast in these months, but you should fast at most one day and break your fast one day.
The sister: as regards my homework afterwards, there was [a] matter that she regretted. The mosque is going to organize the memorization of the Qur'aan. Yesterday was the first trial lesson but she did not go then, and she regretted that very much.
Discussion of student 2
The sister did not do the homework this week, because she was waiting for [the division of tasks] to be shared in the group. Then she did not think of working on the homework and taking the notes.
The teacher: you are in this material already mature enough that you should know yourselves that what you have obtained from this material you should learn as much as possible. You should not wait for a homework assignment. This is not homework but life's work, something you should do in your life.
You should not see the material as though you are in a mathematics lesson, a science lesson or a Qur'aan lesson. This is something you take and set about immediately.
The teacher hopes that for a next time it is for everyone [so] that they do not see it as homework but as something you simply do as a Muslim (man/woman), and that, apart from the existence of a given assignment, you begin practising the material because you should practise it afterwards for the rest of your life.
The sister: I am always occupied with the lessons of 3ilm shu-oon al-usrah (the knowledge of family affairs), but to say to you that I did the homework as it should have been (organized), that is not [the case], but I apply it — al-hamdu lillaah (all praise is due to Allaah) — except that she did not do it in an organized way.
The teacher: the organizing has something beautiful; when you are really occupied with it, and you go and work on it and make an independent programme of it, then it becomes a habit. That it be constructive and that the habit become constructive.
Discussion of student 3
The sister also occupied herself with the homework of the calendar.
A question concerning the calendar:
Is the intention [to include] the months and then every day, or is the intention that we make only the months and put the dates with them?
The teacher: yes, for example the month of Safar, the dates and then what is special about this month.
The sister: as regards the faith (iemaan), it remained as [it was] last week. She has not added other matters this week. She occupied herself with the recitation of the Qur'aan and the conscious contemplation of death.
The teacher: so you did not consciously sit down to look at how I can improve it?
The sister: yes I did, but I have not yet added matters. She was very consciously occupied, and improved the khushoo3 (humble concentration in the prayer).
Discussion of student 4
I think that we obtained the third homework on Thursday via WhatsApp.
Since the last lesson I have realized that I should once again consciously pause at having ikhlaas (a pure intention). Therefore I occupied myself with that last week.
And in addition I occupied myself together with my husband with the mistakes that I make. The mistake that was in first place has not occurred this whole week — al-hamdu lillaah. And my husband and I remain alert to this and also remain in discussion about it, and we shall now — in shaa-a Allaah — focus on the mistake that is [in] second place in the list of priorities.

chapters.title: ٧) عدمُ التركيزِ على الأمورِ الصغيرة، الأخطاءِ الصغيرة، وسَترُها

sections.content:
يقولُ اللهُ سبحانه وتعالى في سورةِ النور (١٩): «إنَّ الذينَ يُحِبُّونَ أن تَشيعَ الفاحشةُ في الذينَ آمَنوا لهم عذابٌ أليمٌ في الدنيا والآخرة، واللهُ يَعلَمُ وأنتم لا تَعلَمون».

ما صلةُ هذه الآيةِ بسَترِ الأمورِ الصغيرةِ وعدمِ التركيزِ على الأمورِ الصغيرة؟

حين يُرَكِّزُ المرءُ على تلك الأمورِ الصغيرةِ فإنَّ التركيزَ سيُوضَعُ على السوء، وحين يُؤَكِّدُ المرءُ باستمرارٍ هذا السوءَ فإنَّ هذا السوءَ سيَبقى أيضًا وَسمًا [خَتمًا] عند الشخصِ المعنيِّ، وهذا يَحرِصُ على أنَّ مثلَ هذا الشخصِ يَصيرُ سَيِّئًا فعلًا. هذه صورةٌ من إشاعةِ السوء. حين لا يَستُرُ المرءُ مثلَ هذا الشخصِ فإنَّه لن يَعودَ يَستَحيي من أن يَرتَكِبَ مثلَ هذا الخَطَأ. ذلك أيضًا إشاعةٌ للسوءِ لأنَّه حين لا يَستَحيي من أن يَرتَكِبَ مثلَ هذا الخَطَأِ فإنَّه سيَرتَكِبُ مثلَ هذا الخَطَأِ بين الناسِ أيضًا، وهناك تكونُ أنت قد أَوصَلتَه إليه. حين يَرتَكِبُ الخَطَأَ بين الناسِ بسببِ مُعامَلتك غيرِ الصحيحةِ له، تكونُ أنت قد أَشَعتَ هذا بين الناس.

إشاعةُ الذنوبِ علنًا صورةٌ من حَملِ الآخرينَ عليها، إشاعةُ السوء.

وأيضًا من غيرِ الصحيحِ أن تُبرِزَ ذنوبًا معيَّنةً لا تَقَعُ في الأسرةِ ولا يَعرِفُها الناسُ في الأسرة. مثلًا زوجتُك لا تَعرِفُ مثلَ هذا الذنبِ فتذهب تتحدَّثُ عنه لأنَّك تريد أُمسيةً مُمتِعةً وليس عندك موضوعٌ آخر. حينئذٍ تكونُ تَرتَكِبُ ذنبًا لأنَّ إظهارَ ذلك الذنبِ يُعَلِّمُ زوجتَك أن تُفتَتَنَ أو يمكن أن تُفتَتَنَ بأن تَرتَكِبَ مثلَ هذا الذنب.

ينبغي أن يَحذَرَ المرءُ ما يقول. لذلك السَّترُ من الأمورِ المهمَّةِ في الإسلام.

ولذلك من أَكثَرِ العِلاجاتِ تَدميرًا وبَشاعةً تنظيمُ «مجموعةِ كلامٍ [دَعمٍ]» يذهب فيها المرءُ يتحدَّثُ عن تجربته في ذنبٍ معيَّن. لأنَّ في تلك اللحظةِ يَتلاشى الشعورُ (وذلك بالضبطِ ما يريدُه شياطينُ الإنسِ هؤلاء) بأنَّ مثلَ ذلك ذنبٌ وأنَّه ينبغي أن يَستَحيَ منه. ذلك يقولونَه أيضًا. يقولون: «إن رأَيتَ أنَّ أُناسًا آخرينَ يَفعَلونَه أيضًا فسيَسهُلُ عليك». ذلك [هو] الدعوةُ إلى الذنوب. لذلك ينبغي أن يَحذَرَ المرءُ عِلاجاتِ الكافرينَ وأن يكون عندهم أصلًا شيءٌ من الخيرِ في عِلمِ نفسهم أو طِبِّهم النفسي.
الجواب: نعم.
الجواب: نعم، مثلًا، أو مُدمِني المُخَدِّرات، أو المُغتَصِبين، أو [مُرتَكِبي] القَتل، أو التدخين. «كيف تَخوضُ التدخين؟ أنا أَخوضُ هذا، والآخرُ يَخوضُ ذاك». يَفعَلون ذلك لكَسرِ التابو [المُحَرَّمِ المسكوتِ عنه]. كلُّ من تَسمَعُه يقولُ «نريد أن نَكسِرَ التابو» فمعناه أنَّه شيطانٌ يَدعو إلى الذنوبِ بأن يَجعَلَها لا تُكرَهُ في قلوبِ الناسِ بعد. ذلك من الأمورِ التي تُفسِدُ العقيدة.

ويقولُ النبيُّ صلَّى الله عليه وسلَّم أيضًا: «من سَتَرَ مسلمًا [أخاه] في الدنيا سَتَرَه اللهُ يومَ القيامة». هذه سُنَّةٌ كَونيَّةٌ (١+١=٢). إن سَتَرتَ أخاك سَتَرَك اللهُ سبحانه وتعالى في الدنيا والآخرة، وإن لم تَستُرْه فَضَحَك اللهُ في الدنيا والآخرة.

وهذا أيضًا أمر. الأمرُ أن تَستُرَ أخاك مبدئيًّا، ويَحرُمُ أن تُظهِرَ أخطاءَ أخيك أو أُختك. وأحيانًا لا ينبغي حتى أن تُناقِشَ تلك الأخطاءَ معه. لأنَّه يَستَحيي منك، وذلك في ذاته كافٍ.

فترى أنَّ كثيرًا من المسلمينَ أَخَذوا أيضًا هذه القَذارةَ من الكافرينَ بأنَّهم يَرَونَ الحَياءَ أمرًا غيرَ صحيح. فيقولون «لا ينبغي أن تَستَحيَ». بلى، ينبغي أن تَستَحيَ، الحَياءُ حَسَنٌ. الحَياءُ يُزَيِّنُ الشخص. يقولُ النبيُّ صلَّى الله عليه وسلَّم: «والحَياءُ شُعبةٌ من الإيمان».

تكونُ قد رَسَمتَ صورةً عند هذا الشخصِ [بحيث] يَنزِعُ الآخرونَ أيضًا إلى أن يُعامِلوه على ذلك الوجه. وتكونُ أيضًا قد سَبَّبتَ أنَّك أَشَعتَ هذا الذنبَ الذي تتحدَّثُ عنه. فتكونُ بذلك أنت أيضًا داعيًا غيرَ مباشرٍ إلى هذا الذنب. لا [يقولُ] النبيُّ صلَّى الله عليه وسلَّم عَبَثًا إنَّ أَشَدَّ الرِّبا [أَربى الرِّبا] أن تَنتَهِكَ عِرضَ أخيك.

فينبغي للمُرَبِّي أن يَعلَمَ أنَّ عليه مسؤوليَّةً كبيرة.
sections.content_nl:
Deze week zullen wij spreken over de wijze waarop verzoend behoort te worden en de wijze waarop de verzoeners behoren te zijn. Wij zullen ook spreken over hoe de man zich op dat moment behoort te gedragen en hoe de vrouw zich op dat moment behoort te gedragen, en hoe het op dat moment zit wat betreft de kinderen.
Wij hebben afgelopen week de stappen van de verbetering behandeld en duidelijk gemaakt dat deze stappen drie stappen in de Qur'aan zijn, die beginnen met:
De vermaning
Het mijden in de slaapplaats
Het slaan
Wij hebben daar uitvoerig over gesproken en de hadieth daarin ook belicht, en wij zeiden dat als het niet meer mogelijk is, wanneer zij er samen [niet] uitkomen, zij dan de mogelijkheid hebben om van de kant van de man en van de kant van de vrouw een wijs persoon te betrekken met wie zij samen tot een verzoening tussen de echtgenoten kunnen komen.
sections.content_en:
This week we shall speak about the manner in which reconciliation should take place and the manner in which the reconcilers should be. We shall also speak about how the man should behave at that moment and how the woman should behave at that moment, and how it is at that moment as regards the children.
We dealt last week with the steps of the improvement and made clear that these steps are three steps in the Qur'aan that begin with:
The admonition
The forsaking in the sleeping places
The striking
We spoke about that at length and highlighted the hadieth in it as well, and we said that if it is no longer possible, when they do [not] come out of [the problem] together, then they have the possibility of bringing in a wise person from the man's side and from the woman's side with whom they can together reach a reconciliation between the two spouses.

chapters.title: ٨) ينبغي أن يُبقيَ المرءُ كلَّ أبوابِ التحسينِ والرجوعِ إلى الله مفتوحةً ولا يُغ

sections.content:
اللهُ سبحانه وتعالى أَبقى أبوابَ التوبةِ مفتوحةً دائمًا إلَّا حين يكون المرءُ في النَّزع [يَموت] أو حين يَرى الشمسَ تَطلُعُ من المغرب، كما قال النبيُّ صلَّى الله عليه وسلَّم أيضًا في حديثٍ صَحَّحَه الإمامُ الألباني: «إنَّ اللهَ يَقبَلُ توبةَ العبدِ ما لم يُغَرغِر». هذا الأمرُ يَحرِصُ على أنَّ من يُرَبَّى يَعلَمُ دائمًا أنَّ [هناك] طريقَ عَودة. بدلًا من أن تَدفَعَه بعيدًا تكونُ تَجذِبُه نحوَ الله سبحانه وتعالى.

لا يجوزُ أن تُثَبِّطَ مثلَ هذا [الشخصِ] عن أن يُؤَدِّيَ التوبة.

النقطتانِ ٩ و١٠ سنَفعَلُهما الأسبوعَ القادم، ثمَّ سنُؤَدِّي أيضًا التعريفَ الثانيَ مع تتمَّةِ تحسينِ الأخطاء.

أسئلة

سؤال: حين تَكتَشِفُ خَطَأً عند أحدٍ وهو لا يَعلَمُ أنَّك تَعلَمُه، فإنَّه لا يجوزُ لك أن تُناقِشَ هذا الخَطَأ. هل ذلك صحيح؟

الجواب: لا يجوزُ لك أن تَكسِرَ حَياءَه. ينبغي حينئذٍ أن تُعطيَ موعظةً عامَّةً غيرَ مباشرة. مثلًا: «تعالَ نَستَمِع إلى هذه المُحاضَرة»، وفي تلك المُحاضَرةِ موعظةٌ عن ذلك الذنبِ الذي يَرتَكِبُه. أو أن تُرسِلَ مَقالًا، أو أن تقولَ: «[هناك] بعضُ الناسِ يَفعَلونَ كذا وكذا، ومثلُ هؤلاءِ ينبغي أن يَخشَوا الله».

ذلك الحَياءُ ينبغي أن تَحفَظَه، تَستُرَه. من الحَسَنِ أن يكون عنده حَياء. وللسببِ نفسِه قد تَقَعُ أنت في مثلِ هذا الموقفِ وتحتاج إلى من يَستُرُك. كلُّ مسلمٍ يحتاج إلى سَتر.

سؤال: شارَكتَ أخيرًا عن المدرسةِ [التي] في الإعلام. ما الذي يُتوقَّعُ بالضبطِ من الجاليةِ المسلمةِ وهل [هو] مهمٌّ لنا أن نَعرِفَه؟

الجواب: نعم، يُتوقَّعُ من الجاليةِ المسلمةِ أوَّلًا أن يكونوا مُنتَبِهينَ لخُطَطِ شياطينِ الإنسِ والجِنّ. تبدأ هذه عند جهازِ الاستخباراتِ [AIVD]، ومدرسةِ الوزاراتِ التي تَحكي الأكاذيبَ، وصولًا إلى الشخصِ الذي يُسَمِّي نفسَه رئيسَ وزراء، وصولًا إلى شخصٍ يُسَمِّي نفسَه «الفُرقاني» وقد ارتَكَبَ مرَّاتٍ كُفرًا أكبر. قال: «أنا الذي يَسخَرُ من النبيِّ صلَّى الله عليه وسلَّم وأَقِفُ مع هؤلاءِ الناس» (انتَصَرَ لـ«شارلي»).

هؤلاءِ الناسُ عندهم خُطَّة، وهي إزالةُ كلِّ وجهٍ من التعليم، ومن السلوكِ الحَسَنِ للإسلام، ومن الخيرِ من هولندا، لأنَّهم يَعلَمون أنَّ لهذا أثرًا حَسَنًا على الشباب.

الأمرُ الثاني أن يَنتَصِرَ المرءُ لهذه المدرسة. أن يُنَبِّهوا الآباءَ ليَستَجيبوا، وأن نَتَكاتَفَ كمسلمينَ لنَحفَظَ مثلَ هذه المدرسة.

لم يَعُدِ السؤالُ هل المدرسةُ مَوثوقةٌ أم لا. المدرسةُ مَوثوقةٌ ١٠٠٪. يَحكون الأكاذيبَ لأنَّ الناسَ يَنفِرونَ من الإرهاب. هذه الأكاذيبُ ستَقَعُ في النهايةِ عليهم. قال أحدُ الصحفيِّينَ لهذا الشخصِ الذي يُسَمِّي نفسَه رئيسَ وزراء: «أنتم لا تأتونَ بحقائق، ليست عندكم حقائق». وجهازُ الاستخباراتِ يُوَضِّحُ أيضًا أنَّه ليست عندهم حقائقُ إلَّا أنَّهم لا يَتَّفِقونَ مع رؤيةِ المدرسة. «أَلَستُم خائفينَ أن تُقاضَوا [على] أنَّكم تُقيمونَ حملةَ تَشهير؟» ينبغي أن نُشيعَ [هذا] بيننا كمسلمين. لا تُصَدِّقوا هؤلاءِ الناس، احرِصوا على أن تَنتَصِروا للمدرسة، أن تُسَجِّلوا في المدرسة، لأمستردامَ وأُوترِخت [معًا]. لا تأخذوا «الفُرقاني» على مَحمَلِ الجِدّ. إن كان عند أحدٍ دعاءٌ أو قال «أنا في لحظةٍ يُرجى أن يُستَجابَ فيها دعائي»، فلْيَدعُ لهذه المدرسةِ ولمن يَبذُلون في هذه المدرسةِ جُهدَهم لحفظِ التعليم، ولْيَدعُ على كلِّ شخصٍ يريد أن يُزيلَ هذا الخير. فيما يَخُصُّ المدرسةَ وأيضًا مؤسَّساتٍ إسلاميَّةً أخرى مُنشَغِلةً بالدعوة. ينبغي أن نَسأَلَه أكثر. هو سبحانه وتعالى في صَفِّنا. لا ينبغي أن نَتَقاتَلَ كمسلمينَ بل أن يَحتَضِنَ أحدُنا الآخرَ لنَنتَصِرَ للإسلامِ والمسلمين.

من السُّنَنِ الكَونيَّةِ المهمَّةِ أنَّ كلَّ شخصٍ يَنتَصِرُ لما يريدُه الكافرُ، [فاعلَم] أنَّه هو نفسُه غيرُ مَوثوق، ولو وَقَفَ في المسجدِ بجِلبابٍ ولِحيةٍ طويلةٍ وأَسالَ بعضَ الدموعِ خُشوعًا، مثلُ هذا الشخصِ لا يجوزُ أن تَثِقَ به. مثلًا [فلانٌ]، و«الفُرقاني»، و[فلانٌ]، و[فلانٌ]، وعندك أكثرُ من ذلك. ناسٌ يَتَظاهَرونَ بأنَّهم أئمَّةٌ أو مَوثوقون.

لماذا؟ لأنَّ مثلَ هذا الشخصِ شيطانٌ يَستعمِلُه هؤلاءِ الناسُ فقط ليَتَسَلَّلَ بين المسلمينَ ويُريدُ أن يُقنِعَ المسلمينَ بفِعلِ السوء.

هم أَصلًا يُنَفِّذونَ خُطَطَ [أعداءِ الإسلام]، وفي هذه اللحظةِ [خُطَطَ] رئيسِ الوزراء، ولكن من أجلِ المَوقِعِ بين المسلمين.

ينبغي أن نَدعوَ لهذه المؤسَّساتِ الإسلاميَّةِ وعلى كلِّ من يريد أن يُلحِقَ بهذه المؤسَّساتِ الإسلاميَّةِ شيئًا.

من المهمِّ أن نَجعَلَ [الأمرَ] جِدِّيًّا، أن يُقنِعَ الشبابُ بعضُهم بعضًا، ويُقنِعوا الآباء. حملةُ التَّشهيرِ هذه بدأَتْ عند [مؤسَّسةِ] «الفِطرة». ثمَّ قاموا بجَولةٍ على كلِّ المساجد، ثمَّ يريدون أن يَنالوا من هذه المدرسة.

سؤال: استعمالُ مصطلحاتٍ معيَّنةٍ كمصطلحِ «السَّلَفيَّة» أو «المنهجِ السَّلَفي». نحن نَتَعَلَّمُ أنَّ عندنا عقيدةَ السنَّة. اليومَ [هناك] فَوضى كثيرةٌ فيما يَخُصُّ تلك المصطلحات. هل تستطيع أن تُوَضِّح؟

الجواب: مثلُ هذا المصطلحِ لُطِّخَ من الصحفيِّينَ ولكن أيضًا من المسلمين. في الحقيقةِ طَرَفانِ [مُتَطَرِّفان]. صحفيُّونَ لا يَعرِفونَ ما تعني السَّلَفيَّةُ، ومسلمونَ يُسيئونَ استعمالَ السَّلَفيَّةِ ويُؤَدُّونَ أفعالًا لا صلةَ لها بالسَّلَفيَّةِ بل بالإجرامِ والكبائرِ أكثر. أفعالُهم لا صلةَ لها بالسَّلَفيَّة. لا ينبغي أن نَبتَعِدَ عن هذا الاسمِ لأنَّ هذا الاسمَ في الحقيقةِ — تقريبًا — مَضمونُ دِيننا، اتِّباعُ السَّلَف. ينبغي أن نُوَضِّحَ للناسِ ما يَعنيه هذا الأمر، أنَّنا نَتَّبِعُ الصحابةَ، نَتَّبِعُ النبيَّ صلَّى الله عليه وسلَّم وفوقَ ذلك نَتَّبِعُ القرآنَ في الوجهِ الذي نُصَلِّي به، وفي الوجهِ الذي نَبيعُ ونَشتري به، وفي الوجهِ الذي نَتصرَّفُ به، وأنَّ هذا ليس جماعةً أو تَجَمُّعًا أو نظريَّة. السَّلَفيَّةُ هي الإسلام. ليس [هناك] إسلامٌ آخر. تُسَمَّى هكذا لأنَّنا نَتَّبِعُ فيها الصحابة. نَتَمَيَّزُ بذلك لأنَّ كلَّ الجماعاتِ الأخرى لا تَتَّبِعُ الصحابة (أهلُ التكفير، التبليغ، الصوفيُّون، إلخ).

أحدُ الصحفيِّينَ سَأَلَ الأستاذَ قبل نحوِ اثنتي عشرةَ أو ثلاثَ عشرةَ سنة: هل أنت سَلَفيّ؟ فقال: لا، لستُ السَّلَفيَّ الذي في رأسك. أنا سَلَفيٌّ يَتَّبِعُ القرآنَ وتفسيرَ النبيِّ والصحابة. لستُ شخصًا يُفَجِّرُ الناسَ أو يَقهَرُ الناس. تلك [هي] السَّلَفيَّةُ التي يَنشُرونَها. يُلَطِّخونَ هذا الأمرَ ليَصرِفوا الناسَ عن الإسلام. إن نَظَرتَ جيِّدًا إلى الوجهِ البَشِعِ لمثلِ هؤلاءِ الناس، ولا سيَّما [برنامجِ] «دعوةِ القرن». أحدُ الناسِ الذي [هو] مُقَدِّمٌ هو «تَيس فان دن برِنك» حين ذَهَبَ يُجري مُقابَلةً مع «يورام فان كلافِرِن» [قال]: «كيف تَدخُلُ دِينًا يقولُ إن خَرَجتَ من هذا الدِّينِ يُقطَعُ رأسُك؟ كيف تَدخُلُ دِينًا يَتَبَرَّأُ من عيسى؟ كيف تَدخُلُ دِينًا يَقهَرُ النساء؟» كان مُنشَغِلًا بمُشاهِديه بتثبيطهم عن دخولِ الإسلام. حتى إنَّ «يورام» استَعمَلَ ذلك لدعوته بأن أَعطى أجوبةً جميلة. ينبغي أن نَسبِقَهم في الدعوةِ الصحيحةِ لأنَّ اللهَ سبحانه وتعالى آتانا هذا الدِّينَ الرائع. ينبغي أن نَحذَرَ ما أمكنَ ألَّا نُدفَعَ أكثرَ إلى زاويةٍ نَخافُ فيها أن نَنسِبَ أنفسنا إلى السَّلَفيَّة. لا يَلزَمُك أن تَتَباهى بها، ولكن ادعُ إلى مَضمونها. حينئذٍ ينبغي أن يكون [الأمرُ] حَسَنًا.
الأستاذ: هؤلاءِ الناسُ يريدون أن يَتَّبِعوا السَّلَفيَّةَ، ولكن لأنَّهم غَلَوا، لم يَعودوا في أمورٍ كثيرةٍ يَتَّبِعونَ الصحابة. فَعَلوا بالضبطِ مثلَ الجماعاتِ الأخرى. قالوا: «نريد منهجَ أهلِ السنَّة». وهو مَبنيٌّ على الدليل. ثمَّ قالوا: «كلُّ من يُبَدِّعُ علماءَنا فليس من أهلِ السنَّة». «لا ينبغي أن تَلتَزِمَ بشخصٍ أو شخصَين، فلماذا تذهبونَ تُجبِرونَنا على أن نَلتَزِمَ بشخصٍ واحد؟» جماعةٌ أخرى (المُعَطِّلة) يقولون: «لا نريد أن نُشَبِّهَ اللهَ بالناسِ لأنَّ اللهَ أعلى من الناس. لذلك نقولُ إنَّ اللهَ لا اسمَ له ولا صفات». قال اللهُ إنَّ له أسماءً وإنَّ له صفات. لا يستطيعونَ أن يَرَوها صفاتٍ لأنَّهم وإلَّا سيُشَبِّهونَ اللهَ بالإنسان. ذلك مثلُ المَداخِلة. بسببِ شهوتهم أرادوا أن يَبتَعِدوا عن الضَّلالِ فوَقَعوا في ضَلالٍ أكبر. يُبَدِّعونَ جميعَ العلماء. في أحدِ تقاريرِ جهازِ الاستخباراتِ قالوا إنَّهم ينبغي أن يَستعمِلوا هذه الفِرقةَ ويَدعَموها عَينًا [مادِّيًّا] حتى يُفَرَّقَ الباقون.
الجواب: هذا العالِمُ أيضًا بدأ هذه الفِتنة، ولذلك تُسَمَّى هذه الفِتنةُ بذلك [بنِسبتها إليه]. ولكن لأكونَ صادقًا مُنصِفًا، فقد تَبَرَّأَ هذا الشيخُ من هؤلاءِ الناسِ الذين يَتصرَّفونَ على هذا الوجه. الأفضلُ أن تُسَمِّيَ هذه الفِرقةَ فِرقةَ التَّبديعِ أو الغُلُوِّ في فِرقةِ التَّبديع.
الجواب: نعم بالطبع.

الواجبُ المنزلي
sections.content_nl:
Ermee behoort begonnen te worden wanneer de scheiding [de breuk (shiqaaq)] gevreesd wordt. Dat zegt Allaah in Soerat An-Nisaa-e: 35: «وإن خِفتُم شِقاقَ بينهما». Interpretatie van de betekenis: «En als jullie een breuk tussen hen beiden vrezen.» Dat betekent dat de man en de vrouw zoveel mogelijk behoren te proberen de zaken samen op te lossen. Wanneer zij vrezen dat zij er samen niet uitkomen en/of uit elkaar kunnen gaan als zij op die wijze doorgaan, dan behoren zij twee personen van beide kanten te betrekken. Als deze twee personen [niet aanwezig] zijn, dan is het belangrijk dat iemand van kennis betrokken wordt die ook kennis en ervaring heeft met de verzoening tussen echtgenoten. Het behoort niet zomaar iemand te zijn; niet iedereen die een les geeft of een lezing houdt kan deze zaak verrichten. Deze zaak kan enkel verricht worden door iemand die kennis en ervaring heeft en deze zaak beheerst en goed onder de knie heeft.
«Islaah dhaat al-bayn», dat wil zeggen de verzoening tussen twee partijen, daarvoor heb je een bepaalde kennis en een bepaalde ervaring nodig. De meeste mensen gaan naar de leraar die voor hen staat en vertrouwen hem omdat zij hen vertrouwen, en leggen vervolgens hun problemen bij hem neer. Dat kan goed verlopen, en kan ook niet goed verlopen. Afhankelijk van of hij deze kennis en ervaring heeft. Het minimum is wat de rechten en plichten van het huwelijk zijn, maar het is ook de kennis van de verzoening tussen twee partijen. Dat is een bepaalde kennis en een andere kennis dan de kennis van het rechtspreken en het vellen van een oordeel.
In de Islaam heb je een algemeen oordeel. Dat kunnen de mensen van kennis verrichten. En de fatwaa kunnen de geleerden geven, hoe die in een bepaalde situatie behoort te worden toegepast. Vervolgens heb je de verzoeners; deze mensen behoren kennis te hebben (nog meer kennis dan degene met de fatwaa), maar ook kennis van hoe zij de mensen bijeen kunnen brengen, wat daarvan de wijsheden zijn, welke methoden daarvoor nodig zijn, en welke rechten en plichten daarvoor nodig zijn.
En je hebt ook een rechter (qaadie); de rechter is iemand die een oordeel velt over een situatie of persoon. Het is belangrijk dat wat deze rechter zegt, uitgevoerd wordt.
[Er is] een verschil tussen het rechtspreken en de verzoening. De verzoening is iets zachts waarmee twee personen bijeengebracht worden, en het kan zijn doordat een van beiden zijn rechten of enige van zijn rechten opgeeft, of doordat zij beiden samen iets van hun rechten opgeven, of doordat degene die werkelijk onrecht pleegt zijn onrecht staakt. En zij beiden behoren dat te doen op een zachte wijze, met vergeving, gemak en eenvoud, zodat zij ook weer nader tot elkaar kunnen komen.
Dat is anders dan het rechtspreken. Het rechtspreken is dat iemand weigert zijn recht op te geven en wil dat de rechter een oordeel velt in zijn zaak. Deze persoon is onrechtvaardig, en deze persoon is rechtvaardig. Dit recht behoort teruggegeven te worden aan die.
De verzoening komt vóór het rechtspreken.
Wij hebben in verscheidene conferenties een definitie van zulk een specialisatie gegeven («islaah dhaat al-bayn»), dat wil zeggen de verzoening tussen twee personen. Niet iedereen kan dit doen, want wie hierin geen ervaring heeft, [bij hem] kan [de zaak] tot scheiding leiden. Deze zaak behoort goed in overweging genomen te worden en ook als voorwaarde voor het slagen van de verzoening opgenomen te worden.
Wanneer iemand de verzoener is, dan is het belangrijk dat de twee personen, de echtgenoten, hem vertrouwen, en dat hij ook gezag [aanzien] over hen beiden heeft. Wanneer hij een van beiden of hen beiden verplicht iets te doen dat tot hun verzoening leidt, dat zij dat ook doen.
Dat is een belangrijke voorwaarde die aanwezig behoort te zijn in de verzoening: de verzoener behoort aanzien te hebben bij de twee personen. Niet bij een van beiden en niet bij de ander, of minder.
sections.title_nl: Wanneer behoort ermee begonnen te worden?
sections.content_en:
It should be begun when the separation [the breach (shiqaaq)] is feared. That Allaah says in Soerat An-Nisaa-e: 35: «وإن خِفتُم شِقاقَ بينهما». Interpretation of the meaning: «And if you fear a breach between them both.» That means that the man and the woman should try as much as possible to solve the matters together. When they fear that they do not come out of [the problem] together and/or may separate if they continue in that manner, then they should bring in two persons from both sides. If these two persons are [not present], then it is important that someone of knowledge be brought in who also has knowledge and experience with the reconciliation between spouses. It should not be just anyone; not everyone who gives a lesson or delivers a lecture can perform this matter. This matter can only be performed by someone who has knowledge and experience and masters this matter and has a firm command of it.
«Islaah dhaat al-bayn», that is, the reconciliation between two parties, for it you need a specific knowledge and a specific experience. Most people go to the teacher who is before them and trust him because they trust them, and then lay their problems before him. That may go well, and may also not go well. Depending on whether he has this knowledge and experience. The minimum is what the rights and duties of the marriage are, but it is also the knowledge of the reconciliation between two parties. That is a specific knowledge and a different knowledge from the knowledge of adjudication and issuing a ruling.
In Islaam you have a general ruling. That the people of knowledge can perform. And the fatwaa the scholars can give, how it should be applied in a specific situation. Then you have the reconcilers; these people should have knowledge (still more knowledge than the one with the fatwaa), but also knowledge of how they can bring people together, and what the wisdoms of that are, and which methods are needed for it, and which rights and duties are needed for it.
And you also have a judge (qaadie); the judge is someone who issues a ruling about a situation or person. It is important that what this judge says be carried out.
[There is] a difference between adjudication and reconciliation. Reconciliation is something gentle by which two persons are brought together, and it can be by one of the two giving up his rights or some of his rights, or by them both together giving up something of their rights, or by the one who truly commits injustice ceasing his injustice. And they both should do that in a gentle manner, with pardon, ease and simplicity, so that they can also draw near to one another again.
That is different from adjudication. Adjudication is that someone refuses to give up his right and wants the judge to issue a ruling in his case. This person is a wrongdoer, and this person is just. This right should be returned to that one.
Reconciliation comes before adjudication.
We have given a definition of such a specialization in several conferences («islaah dhaat al-bayn»), that is, the reconciliation between two. Not everyone can do this, because whoever has no experience in it, [with him] [the matter] can lead to separation. This matter should be well taken into account and also included as a condition for the success of the reconciliation.
When someone is the reconciler, then it is important that the two persons, the spouses, trust him, and that he also has authority [standing] over them both. When he obliges one of them or them both to do something that leads to their reconciliation, that they do that as well.
That is an important condition that should be present in the reconciliation: the reconciler should have standing with the two persons. Not with one of them and not with the other, or less.

chapters.title: ١) نَظِّم ملاحظاتك واصرِف على ذلك ساعتين على الأقلّ.

sections.content:
٢) النقاطُ التي تناولناها من النقطةِ الثانيةِ إلى النقطةِ الثامنة، أن تُمارَسَ، ينبغي أن يُمارَسَ منها ثلاثُ نقاطٍ على الأقلّ، وإن رأَيتَ أنَّ في سلوكك خَطَأً تناولناه فأن تُحَسِّنَ هذا السلوكَ وتُؤَدِّيَ نَقيضَه.

الدرس التاسع والأربعون — الأحد ١٧ مارس ٢٠١٩

الواجبُ المنزلي
sections.content_nl:
Het hoeft niet [te zijn] na de derde fase van de verbetering, of na de eerste of de tweede. Zij beiden kunnen zien dat zij er niet uitkomen. De vrouw is vermaand, en de man is vermaand, en zij beiden komen er niet uit. Dan is het belangrijk dat zij niet wachten op de tweede en de derde fase, maar dat zij meteen een verzoener vragen om tussen hen beiden te verzoenen.
Dat betekent dat deze zaak (de verzoening) ook behoort te gebeuren in een fase waarin de partners elkaar nog het goede wensen en niet [verkeren] in een toestand waarin zij beiden elkaar als vijand zien, want de verzoening zal dan een veel geringer effect hebben dan wanneer zij zou plaatsvinden tijdens een geschil dat nog niet tot vijandschap heeft geleid.
In deze fase is het ook belangrijk dat zij beiden hun oprechtheid en hun eerlijkheid bewaren.
En dat zij voor zichzelf geen front [partij] vormen, maar zich richten naar het welbehagen van Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa. Wanneer men het welbehagen van Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa niet meer voor ogen houdt, dan zal hij niet [ernaartoe] werken. Hij zal werken naar zijn intentie.
Op dat moment is het ook belangrijk dat een oprecht, betrouwbaar persoon ingezet wordt, zodat Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa ook tussen hen beiden kan verzoenen.
sections.title_nl: Wanneer kan zulk een verzoener gevraagd worden?
sections.content_en:
It does not have to be [after] the third stage of the improvement, or after the first or the second. They both can see that they are not coming out of [the problem]. The woman has been admonished, and the man has been admonished, and they both are not coming out of [the problem]. Then it is important that they do not wait for the second and the third stage but that they immediately request a reconciler to reconcile between them both.
That means that this matter (the reconciliation) should also happen in a stage in which the partners still want the good for one another and are not [in] a situation in which they both see the other as an enemy, because the reconciliation will then have a far lesser effect than if it were to happen during a conflict that has not yet led to enmity.
In this stage it is also important that they both preserve their sincerity and their truthfulness.
And that they do not form a front [party] for themselves but direct themselves towards the pleasure of Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa. When one no longer keeps the pleasure of Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa before his eyes, then he will not work [towards it]. He will work according to his intention.
At that moment it is also important that a truthful, trustworthy person be used, so that Allaah subhaanahu wa ta3aalaa can also reconcile between them both.
sections.title_en: When can such a reconciler be requested?
